title: Terrain proposal delta visualization + selected-volume reporting
description: Make terrain proposals visibly show the delta they propose: lattice-sampled translucent proposed surface (replacing the perimeter-only flat-lid ghost) + civil-style cut/fill heatmap drape (red=cut, blue=fill, graded by real-meter depth) vs the pristine read-only TerrainHeightField, live from the armed tool before commit, and on baked earthwork regions after commit (P1). Selected-volume report: area + true cut/fill/net m3 (one shared composite integrator, map-scale-authority units) + per-item breakdown + contained nodes + copy-as-TSV (P2). Cross-sections deferable (P3); assets-in-volume utility takeoff future/spec-only (P4).
origin: in-app finding F5 (2026-10-25): proposals post/save but show no visible transformation of the delta
alignment: P0 BIM/BUILDER + analytics-first (Spatial Builder Program follow-on to sculpt_earthwork_regions D-A8; strategic roadmap spatial-analytics thesis). Industry anchor: Civil 3D/InfraWorks/Trimble existing-vs-proposed surface pair, cut/fill heatmap, volume report, cross-sections; game-builder live ghost.
root_causes: R-1 ghost = earcut of footprint perimeter only (fe-terrain/src/terrain_proposal.rs:258) -> flat lid, interior cannot show delta
R-2 ghosts rebuild only on ActivePetalTerrain.revision (fe-terrain/src/terrain_plugin.rs:1195) -> no pre-commit preview path exists
R-3 earthwork regions skip ghosts and bake into chunks (terrain_plugin.rs:1228, :1432) -> no before/after comparison
R-4 report totals are area x |delta| (fe-ui/src/panels/proposal_report_panel.rs:123, :321); true proposal_cut_fill (terrain_proposal.rs:396) unused in prod
notes: 2026-10-25: track drafted (docs only) from in-app F5. Inventory found the cut/fill math complete and tested (sculpt::cut_fill_volume, proposal_cut_fill, EarthworkRegion::cut_fill, bake EarthworkVolumeReport); the gap is ghost geometry (R-1), no preview path (R-2), baked regions without comparison (R-3), and an approximate report (R-4). Open decisions OD-1..OD-12 proceed on recommended defaults unless ratified (plan section 0).
